verdict.rationale: Runway's own API covers a broad slice of what the app does: generative video, image and audio models, text-to-video, Characters, Recipes, Model Routers, and Workflows built in the Runway app and published as private, versioned endpoints. It also ships an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and an SDK. However, the evidence never claims UI/API parity, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: an explicit parity claim or feature matrix, API coverage of Brand Kits, the AI video editor, 4K upscaling, Runway Ads publishing, App Studio and the agentic collaborator, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Workflows: node-graph pipelines built in the Runway app and published as private, versioned endpoints
Runway Dev lets you bring video, image and audio models from Runway and other labs, including Kling, Seedance and GPT Image, directly into your apps, products, platforms and websites through one API.
